title: DCP Coherent Pauli-X Label-Negation and Multi-Stage Sign-Rectified CNOT Routing Bridge
claims: Conjugating any single-qubit DCP phase state rho(a, s, gamma) by the secret-independent Pauli-X gate satisfies X rho(a, s, gamma) X == rho((-a) mod q, s, gamma) identically.

At level k = 3 (mod 8), syndrome-conditioned Pauli-X sign rectification aligns the d_2 = 0 Stage-2 CNOT branch to 0 mod 8 across 100% of odd-mod-4 wire pairs in {2, 6}^2 (vs. 50% without rectification).
